full_fusion_v2.evidence: Predictions, gates, metrics and histories exist for all three seeds and were produced by exactly this configuration. Checkpoints were recovered from Kaggle staging and VERIFIED in the Phase 3 addendum: each loaded strictly against the reference architecture (578/578 keys, 0 missing, 0 unexpected, 0 shape mismatches), retained a learned input-dependent gate, and reproduced its stored clean-test predictions exactly (0.0000 pp accuracy difference, 0 predicted-label mismatches, max absolute probability difference ~4e-06 from float non-determinism). Verified per seed: 42: True, 43: True, 44: True.
full_fusion_v2.consequence: full_fusion_v2 needs no retraining: both its predictions and its weights are available and verified. no_tta becomes a genuine evaluation-only re-scoring of these weights.

no_tta.candidate: evaluation-only re-scoring of the recovered full_fusion_v2 checkpoints
no_tta.evidence: no_tta differs from the reference only at inference, so it is a re-scoring of the same weights rather than a new training run. Those weights now exist and are verified for all three seeds, so the evaluation-only route is available: each no_tta cell uses the recovered checkpoint of the SAME seed.
no_tta.consequence: No training. Each cell loads publication_runs/recovered_checkpoints/clean/full_fusion_v2/seed_<N>/checkpoint.pth and scores without TTA, roughly 3 minutes per seed.

no_ema.candidate: evaluation-only using pre-EMA weights of the reference run
no_ema.evidence: Verified in src/train_ablation.py rather than assumed: the training loop sets eval_model = ema.ema when --ema is given and checkpoints copy.deepcopy(eval_model.state_dict()) (pattern found: True). The raw non-EMA weights are therefore never written to disk.
no_ema.consequence: no_ema is a training-time ablation here, not an evaluation-time one. Validation-based model selection in the reference used the EMA copy, so a no_ema run would also select a different epoch. It must be trained.

protocol_differences: no discriminative learning rate (reference uses backbone_lr_mult=0.1)
TTA not used (reference uses hflip TTA)
no auxiliary branch loss (reference uses aux_weight=0.3)
head is Linear->BatchNorm1d->ReLU->Dropout->Linear on the final 1280-d pooled map; the control requires the FusionV2 projection (Linear->LayerNorm->GELU) over 1432-d multi-scale features
cnn_branch_only.evidence: Compared field-by-field against the reference configuration read from runs_v2_clean/fusion_v2_seed42/metrics.json. 5 protocol differences found.
cnn_branch_only.consequence: Reusing this run would confound the branch ablation with differences in head architecture, learning-rate schedule, weight averaging and inference protocol. It is a legitimate baseline for the earlier ablation table, but not a control for THIS one.

label_isolation: The duplicate-disjoint external subset is scored once per run, after training and after validation-based model selection have finished. Its labels are never read during training, validation, early stopping, threshold choice or configuration selection. The trainer selects on validation accuracy carved from the TRAINING partition only.
